# W5 — the published bond-wire cases: NOT DONE

The owner named M. Shah, *Temperature rise and fusing current in wire bonds for high power RF
applications*, as the validator for the wire model (brief 72, R-em3d72-2a).

**This case is not done: the paper has not arrived.** Brief 72 forbids reconstructing its equations or
its data from memory, so nothing here is. When the PDF is provided, this folder will hold: a README that
paraphrases the paper's model (quoting nothing) and cites it by author and title, and a table of the
published temperature-rise and fusing-current results that brief 77's gate compares against.

Until then W1–W4 (`../wire-*`) stand in; they are standard physics derived in their own READMEs and are
**not** attributed to this paper.
